en.description: Turn confirmed SKU facts and product photos into three to six AI ecommerce detail modules with a visual story and layout guide for Amazon A+ Content, product detail pages, brand storefronts, Shopify product pages, and launch campaigns. Create product feature visuals, material details, use scenes, size or comparison modules, packaging images, and brand-story imagery for a clear, scrollable product experience.
en.summary: Create three to six coordinated ecommerce detail modules with a product story and layout guide.
en.title: Ecommerce Detail Module Studio: A+ Content Visuals
